selection: All remaining uniquely paired mug/cup plus table test scenes, excluding the 20-scene development split and 10-scene exploratory pilot.
relation_annotation: Inspect RGB image and 2D boxes only. Positive iff paired mug/cup visibly rests on paired table. Negative or uncertain scenes receive no correction; report all candidates.
basis: The exploratory ten-scene pilot showed that 0.2 m table uncertainty over-trusted broad table boxes. A separate 20-scene development benchmark had four table centers averaging 0.793 m 3D error. Round table uncertainty to 0.8 m; other values and offset stay as in the pilot.
primary_metric: mean 3D centroid error of positively labeled cups and mugs
secondary_metrics: mean 3D centroid error across both objects in each positive pair
number of positive children improved versus worsened
limitations: The remaining scenes are few and some may be nearby frames. This is a small confirmation diagnostic, not an independent statistical benchmark or novel-method proof.
